- zzz-release/gate.py:5 — correctness — Accept releases that meet the approval minimum — `approved(2, minimum=2)` now returns `False`, contradicting the module’s “at least the configured number of approvals” contract. Your strict comparison excludes equality; the existing tests exercise only counts above and below the threshold. — This blocks otherwise eligible releases and forces an extra approval beyond the configured requirement. — Fix: Restore `>=` and extend `test_approved_release` to cover equality.
